annotation_policy: Reference regions were drawn by visual comparison before inference. They identify major visible construction events, not exact footprints or permit compliance. Vintage years are collection labels; exact flight dates are not published by this WMS. No drone images were used.
matching_policy: IoU>=0.25 or reference coverage>=0.5, with proposal area<=4x reference area and compatible change type. Only proposals with >=50% of their area inside the declared evaluation bounds are scored. Multiple supporting proposals are recorded, not converted into calibrated confidence.

cases.title: Norra kajen waterfront housing

dated_evidence.supports: Developer announces the first 360 dwellings stage, construction planned for autumn 2020, occupancy for spring 2023.
Owner describes Lastkajen (98 homes) planned for late 2022 and Pollaren (262 homes) planned for 2023.
Owner property list maps Lastkajen 1 and Pollaren 1 to street addresses.

evidence_gaps: Current applicable protection boundaries and exact revocation extent still require decision-level verification; waterfront proximity or a coarse protection polygon is insufficient.
No building permit conditions or exemption decision has been verified for these exact objects.
Other site work outside the declared review bounds is unscored.

plan_evidence.geometry_limit: Approximate annotation regions, not surveyed parcel or building footprints. Bbox search alone also returned DP550, which does not intersect either reference region.

documents.supports: County opinion refers to its 2011-04-12 order revoking shore protection within the plan. Page visually inspected.

Page 5 legend a2 denotes revoked shore protection; page 22 (printed16, 2018-10-15, Dnr2014-01030) gives reasoning; page50 (printed3, 2018-10-11, SBN2014-01030) records county comments and reduced water-area revocation. Pages visually inspected.

plan_evidence.interpretation: Waterfront construction is a useful legal-escalation control: plan-specific revocations can contradict broad protection-layer screening. Verify current exact boundaries and the applicable adopted decision before a legal conclusion.

cases.ground_truth: Sports pitches/paint/season differ; no major building change is visible in this crop. Designed to detect court/vegetation false positives.

cases.title: Identical-image construction-site control
cases.ground_truth: Exact same cached PNG bytes for both vintages. Hallucination control, not a substitute for different-date controls.

scoring_revision: Direction labels tightened after independent scoring review; frozen spatial reference bounds, model prompt and inference outputs were not changed. Spatial hits and semantic type mismatches are reported separately.

demo_workflows.prompt_sv: Jämför ortofoton 2019 och 2023 för Baldershallen. Visa förändringskandidater, källor, tidsintervall och misslyckade bildrutor. Kontrollera dem mot bilderna och sök relevanta lovhandlingar. Dra ingen slutsats om olovligt byggande utifrån en bildförändring.

Utgå från förändringskandidaterna för Baldershallen och ärende BYGG2021-000790 på HAGA 4:51. Identifiera situationsplanens godkända version och sida innan läge eller mått jämförs. Om ritningen saknas, redovisa exakt vilket underlag som behövs. Påstå ingen avvikelse från lov utan det underlaget.

Granska de nya byggnaderna på Norra kajen mot aktuellt strandskydd och detaljplanerna DP376 och DP486. Gör riktig geometrisk skärning, inte bara bbox-sökning. Kontrollera upphävande och rätt beslutsversion. Visa källor, kartkandidater och kvarstående frågor; läge vid vattnet bevisar inte att strandskydd gäller.
